description: BCTS Planned Roads is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by BC Timber Sales. These planned roads assist BC Timber Sales (BCTS) in accessing sustainable harvest units to provide the cost and price benchmark for timber harvested from public land in British Columbia. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher BC Timber Sales . Its tags are BC Timber Sales, BCTS, CP, CP RP, Cutting Permit. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
